content.title: Where to watch 76ers vs. Nuggets NBA game free tonight during NBC and FuboTV dispute
content.text: Updated: Mar. 17, 2026, 6:30 p.m.Published: Mar. 17, 2026, 6:30 p.m.Denver Nuggets center Nikola Jokić (15) and Los Angeles Lakers forward Rui Hachimura (28) in the second half of an NBA basketball game Thursday, March 5, 2026, in Denver.AP Photo/David ZalubowskiIf you purchase a product through a link on our site, we may receive compensation.By Dustin Hockensmith | dhockensmith@pennlive.comThe Philadelphia 76ers limp to Denver on Tuesday as heavy underdogs missing several key lineup pieces against Nikola Jokic and the Nuggets at Ball Arena. The game is scheduled to start at 10 p.m. ET (8 p.m. MT) with TV coverage on NBC and streaming on-demand.NBC is part of the NBC Universal family of networks currently blacked out on FuboTV during ongoing contract negotiations. Available streaming alternatives are listed below.How to watch 76ers vs. Nuggets on TV and stream without cable:When: Tuesday, March 17 at 10 p.m. ET (8 p.m. MT)Where: Ball Arena, Denver, Colo. TV channel: NBC and PeacockStreaming on: DirecTV (free trial) | SlingTV (low intro rate) | Peacock ($10.99+/mo.)76ers vs. Nuggets: The matchupThe 76ers will play without leading scorer Tyrese Maxey and starting guard Kelly Oubre Jr. for extended periods, and they will also likely be down center Joel Embiid for Tuesday’s matchup in Denver. Philadelphia has managed to stay in the postseason hunt despite the continued injury issues, and the team enters the week in ninth place in the Eastern Conference with a 37-31 record. The Sixers are just 1.5 games outside the top-6 cutoff and have an 8.5-game cushion over the Milwaukee Bucks to hold onto a spot in the East’s Play-In Tournament. The Nuggets are big 15.5-point favorites over the shorthanded 76ers, and they play six of their next eight games at Ball Arena. Denver is engaged in a fight to the finish in the Western Conference, currently sitting second in the Northwest Division and fifth overall with its 41-27 season record. The Nuggets took down top West contenders in the Houston Rockets (129-93) and San Antonio Spurs (136-131) in back-to-back games before falling to the Lakers in LA (127-125 in OT) last time out. 76ers vs. Nuggets: Know your live streamsDirecTV (free trial): DirecTV offers a 5-day free trial and a total of $30 off over the first three full months for the Choice Package, which includes 125-plus channels and access to ESPN Unlimited, a $29.99 standalone value featuring all ESPN channels and ESPN+.SlingTV (low intro rate): First full month of streaming runs as low as $29.99 with current offer for 50% off Sling’s Orange & Blue Plan. Day passes are also available for 24 hours ($4.99), as well as three-day ($9.99) and seven-day access ($14.99).Peacock ($10.99+/mo.): Peacock’s library of live sports is growing and features exclusive NFL and college football games, all in addition to NBC Universal movies, television series, and more.TOP STREAMING PICKSBY PENNLIVE.COM
